thread:
alec: Heads-up: small handbook update live for the Sabbatical & Extended Leave policy. Also rolling out a required 6-minute acknowledgment for managers and employees eligible for sabbatical. Please complete by 2026-01-15. Link: https://handbook.redwood.company/sabbatical

alec: The page clarifies eligibility (tenure thresholds), approval workflow, and coverage planning expectations. Acknowledgment asks you to confirm youve read the policy and discussed coverage with your manager/team where relevant.

mira: Quick q: does the tenure calculation include previous service if rehired within 12 months?

alec: Yes  rehired employees within 12 months can count prior service. We added explicit language and an example in the handbook.

ben: For managers: will the acknowledgment show up as a manager boolean vs employee? I need to filter by manager confirmations for planning coverage.

alec: Yep  tracker records `acknowledged_by_employee` and `manager_confirmed_coverage` booleans. CSV export will include `employee_email, manager_email, tenure_months, acknowledged_at, manager_confirmed_coverage, exemption_note`.

zoe: Contractors question: long-term contractors who have been on continuous contracts for >24 months — do they count toward eligibility?

alec: Sabbatical policy applies only to benefits-eligible employees marked in HRIS. Contractors, even long-term, are not eligible unless explicitly moved to employee status. If you have edge cases, DM people-ops and we'll advise.

ben: Is there an exemption for employees who took a similar long-term leave through a previous employer within the last year?

alec: No automatic exemption. If someone had a recent equivalent arrangement, they can request an exception via people-ops with supporting docs; decisions handled case-by-case.

hr-bot: Automated assignment: 68 employees assigned to "Sabbatical & Extended Leave 6min acknowledgment". Due: 2026-01-15. Tracker: https://docs.redwood.company/training-tracker (snapshot 2025-12-20 09:00 UTC) :bell:

mira: For the manager CSV, can we include `team_size` and `planned_coverage_start_date`? Im building a capacity forecast.

alec: Added those columns for the manager export. We'll publish the CSV to #people-ops-managers on Monday.

zoe: Missed deadline process? Some folks may be on leave and miss the window.

alec: We'll send reminders at 7 days and 48 hours. If someone is on leave during the window, managers can mark them as deferred in the tracker; send a note to people-ops-accomms@redwood.com for formal extensions. Missed > 30 days = manager follow-up and flag in HR dashboard. No punitive action for simple miss.

ben: Any suggested copy for the manager digest?

alec: Suggested blurb: "Updated Sabbatical & Extended Leave policy + 6-min acknowledgment for eligible employees and managers. Completion tracked via training tracker; deadline 2026-01-15. Managers: confirm coverage plans for team members going on extended leave."

mira: Thanks  Ill add that to the digest and ping if I need the raw CSV.

alec: Thanks everyone. Ping me with questions or edge cases. :white_check_mark:
